data_objects.name: department_budget_year_crosswalk
data_objects.meaning: Organizational crosswalk of municipal departments, department identifiers, higher-level department groups, and budget-year date boundaries.
data_objects.notes: The table describes one common budget-year interval and does not contain budget amounts.

variables.name: coa_dept_id
variables.meaning: Numeric-looking department identifier in the COA coding system.

variables.name: github-dept-code
variables.meaning: Short alphabetic department code used by the source's GitHub-oriented naming convention.

variables.name: dept_group
variables.meaning: Higher-level organizational or service grouping assigned to the department.

variables.name: budget_year_start
variables.meaning: Start date of the budget-year interval, encoded as month/day/year text.

variables.name: budget_year_end
variables.meaning: End date of the budget-year interval, encoded as month/day/year text.

structure.description: Each row represents one department during the declared budget-year interval; Department Name, coa_dept_id, and github-dept-code act as one-to-one candidate identifiers within the table.
dept_group creates a one-to-many grouping in which multiple departments can belong to the same higher-level service group.
budget_year_start and budget_year_end jointly define the fiscal interval, and source rows are ordered alphabetically by Department Name.

uncertainties: The evidence does not expand COA or document whether either department-code system remains stable across other budget periods.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in train.csv and its declared packet.
